svg.title: Pellier governed workshop architecture
svg.desc: The participant uses Storefront, Operator, Observatory, and Code Editor. The Pellier backend uses Cognito identity and AgentCore Memory context. The managed shopper dispatcher runs in AgentCore Runtime, calls Gateway with the caller token, and reaches Lambda tools only after AgentCore Policy authorizes the call. Lambda uses RDS Data API to reach Aurora PostgreSQL. Operator investigation runs in its own IAM-authenticated AgentCore Runtime, invoked by the backend after scoped evidence reads; staff confirmation precedes the governed tool call. Observatory correlates service evidence and database records.
svg.text: Pellier: governed search from request to evidence
